scripts.build: npm run build -w @go-wind/flow-designer-core && npm run build -w @go-wind/flow-designer-vue && npm run build -w @go-wind/flow-designer-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @go-wind/flow-designer-core && npm run typecheck -w @go-wind/flow-designer-vue && npm run typecheck -w @go-wind/flow-designer-react
scripts.demo: npm run build -w @go-wind/flow-designer-core && npm run build -w @go-wind/flow-designer-vue && npm run build -w @go-wind/flow-designer-react && npm run dev -w @go-wind/flow-designer-demo
